**Wrote the handoff to `HANDOFF.md`.** It has the full root cause with the log lines quoted exact.

The impact window is `02:14:07Z` to `02:31:52Z`, seventeen minutes and forty-five seconds. No `200` response appears after `02:14:03Z`, so treat all of it as customer-facing.

One gap you should know about before you send it. I could not give the ioredis version. There is no lockfile and no `node_modules` here, only the `^5.4.1` range in `package.json`.

The doc says that plainly and warns against checking the changelog against `5.4.1`. That is the floor of the range, not what ran.

Run `npm ls ioredis` on the prod host and drop the real number in.
